verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no training-use policy, no-training commitment, or opt-out control for Cognee or Cognee Cloud. The documented ability to run Cognee locally or self-hosted without an account is a related deployment option, not a documented guarantee that data is excluded from AI model training, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
